Short title and commencement

ACT XXXVIII of 1997
ACT XXXVIII of
1997
NEGOTIABLE
INSTRUMENTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to
amend the
Negotiable
Instruments Act, 1881
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th December, 1997]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the Acting President on the
3rd December, 1997, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Negotiable Instruments
(Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 25, Act XXVI of 1881

ACT XXXVIII of 1997
ACT XXXVIII of

NEGOTIABLE
INSTRUMENTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to
amend the
Negotiable
Instruments Act, 1881
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th December, 1997]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the Acting President on the
3rd December, 1997, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 25,
Act XXVI of 1881.--In the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 (XXVI of 1881),
in section 25, for the Explanation the following shall be substituted,
namely:--
"Explanation.--The
expression "public holiday" shall mean the day or days declared by
the Federal Government, by Notification in the Official Gazette, to be public
holidays."
